 Wednesday’s slate features a marquee matchup between the Boston Celtics and Denver Nuggets, with Jayson Tatum and Nikola Jokić headlining the showdown.
 Boston enters at 11-3, holding one of the league’s best records and looking to rebound after a 115-105 loss to Orlando that snapped its six-game winning streak. Denver is 7-5 and also coming off a defeat, falling 117-105 to Phoenix.
 Other games on Wednesday’s schedule include the Hawks vs. Thunder, Warriors vs. Mavericks, and Jazz vs. Lakers.
